persistence.description: nothing changes: flat, 0 pp, no onset

rank_correlation.note: UNGRADED - fewer than 4 places with variation on both sides

caveats: A few events prove the machinery, not the forecasting power: every rate here rests on a handful of places for one or two events. One graded place moves a hit rate by tens of points. Read these as a worked, auditable comparison, not a skill estimate. The simulator's traffic is modelled from lane structure, not the historical fleet.

capacity_loss_basis.source: Panama Canal Authority (ACP) Customer Advisory 30 Oct 2023, via DB Group: https://www.dbgroup.net/en/news/panama-canal-daily-transit-limited-due-drought
capacity_loss_basis.text: Derived by arithmetic only on the two sourced ACP slot counts: normal schedule ~36 transits/day, crisis minimum 18/day from 1 Feb 2024; capacity_loss = 1 - 18/36 = 0.5. No conversion factor involved.
